reason: Not refuted. The core correction is valid arithmetic, and the action is info-only with zero cost. (1) VALUE: exact x138 copies all get the same private score X. X's private rank is therefore 1 + the number of teams whose better final beats X. A private medal thus needs #37 to beat most of the growing public-variant crowd, not only the copies. My own count without the MC: 110 teams at >=0.960, plus 0.5-0.8 x 410-580 teams at 0.954-0.959, plus ~20-100 non-copy teams at 0.953, plus ~30 at 0.948-0.952. That puts X+ at rank ~365-700 against bronze ~#400. The scratchpad r16/final_runs.txt reproduces the quoted A numbers (overfit 0.70-0.89, mid 0.46-0.70, central 0.27-0.49). (2) MISATTRIBUTION: the 26 Sep 16:54Z entry (CONTEXT l.2324-2334) already had '~250-400 teams end above us' and named 'bronze inside the variant crowd' as a no-medal path. The broken premise comes from round15 v_recheck_r15-rc-c (3), which reads the PUBLIC block ranks (#342-723) as if they were X's private rank, and from the I-297/R12 hedge reasoning. Relative to 16:54Z the change is quantitative: faster field growth (520-690 vs 450-550) and a higher share of rivals beating X. (3) MODEL GAP: in forecast_mc2.py every field has beta >= 0 and a genuine share g >= 0.10. No world has public-selected tweaks of an already tuned x138 that are net negative on private, which is the classic shake-up case. In that world X+ ranks ~250-350 and bronze is likely whenever #37 > X. So the 0.55 centre and the 0.85 upper end are biased low, and the range is skewed toward us. (4) The '30 Sep read' target is not directly readable: the private LB shows 3-dp scores, and variants share the bin with copies. (5) FEASIBILITY: no build, no submit, no rule or pair change. R1-R10 and R8 are untouched, and I-092 holds if the numbers are labelled illustrative.
